scope.schedule: original 795; census only, no replay of those sessions
scope.independent_unit: Spot filled BUY order/cohort (not sleeves/polls); Coin filled campaign (not IOC fragments/polls)
scope.default_changes: Only after qualified actual-account evidence; cheap screen cannot promote

alpha.name: perp-chasing-veto
alpha.rule: Veto genuine NEW BUY if completed paired UTC-day perp imbalance > 0 and spot imbalance <= 0; no held changes
alpha.imbalance: 2 * sum(taker-buy quote volume) / sum(total quote volume) - 1
alpha.availability: day end + 60000 ms; same UTC day, six distinct complete perp4h bins, no forming bars; historical availability is an assumption, forward must record real receipt
alpha.missing: retain incumbent for this optional feature; mandatory incumbent crowding safety stays
alpha.diagnostic: Avoided settled cost-net entry P/L; open residue separately marked/excluded from closed gate; no account curve scaling
alpha.control: Uniform removal of the same aggregate entry notional fraction from all settled entry cohorts, diagnostic only

beta.name: held-risk-trim
beta.coin: During HOLD after entry session, long notional/equity > 1.25 times current existing target_fraction(20 completed daily returns, friction .0011) * primary7.5 or macro3.6: reduce to that target; one first legal opportunity per campaign for census
beta.spot: Per filled owned sleeve record entry equity fraction q*entryPrice*(clip(4*ATR14/completedClose,.10,.30)+.0035)/equity after entry; during HOLD, if current owned q*mark*(current clipped ATR fraction+.0035)/equity > 1.25 times committed fraction, trim to committed fraction. Aggregate siblings by original BUY order. No ordinary-exit override, no dust top-up
beta.execution_limits: market precision Spot .00001 and notional5; Coin .001 and notional5; no private actions. Persist reduced requested Coin quantity before any subsequent add; preserve protection and reconcile unknown replies
beta.diagnostic: First trigger: pro-rata remaining baseline cash proceeds / P&L + future actual funding, minus conservative immediate trim proceeds/costs. Entry costs already sunk. No hypothetical reinvestment. Uniform same removed inventory fraction at first eligible HOLD is lower-exposure control
beta.continuity: Trim only; Spot held no-topup and consumed campaign stay. Coin never increase previous commitment; no background/offline client changes

gates.economic: Avoided net P/L divided by affected notional strictly positive overall and each era; improvement versus equal aggregate fraction lower-exposure control strictly positive overall. Closed cohort requires >=99.9% original net quantity sold; residual is separately disclosed. Risk trim uses remaining quantity closure >=99.9%.
gates.rejection: Coverage/count/cost/control/era gate failure closes fixed mechanism with diagnostic evidence; no parameter grid or execution scaffolding
gates.entrant: Only entrants implement execution adapter and run actual independent accounts in fixed 2021Q1 and 2022Q2 windows, same starts/capital/costs; reject if either loses return AND worsens MDD, or no legal action; pass then preregister additional full comparison before any795

budget.archives: small existing spot1d/perp4h ZIPs only; hash/parse once, save input+feature cache; no14GB aggTrade scan
budget.full_software: exact workflow once per repository at end; affected fixes only; [skip ci] integration avoids duplicate remote suite
budget.accounts: strict serial, no UID/HOME/lock changes; original evidence source kept
